10A.
Request to vacate an existing biological open space easement. Applicant: Brett Heers; Location: 3465 Bumann Road. Contact Person: City Planner Sapa'u
THIS ITEM HAS BEEN CONTINUED TO THE NOVEMBER 8, 2017 CITY COUNCIL MEETING AND ONLY APPEARS ON THE AGENDA BECAUSE IT WAS LEGALLY NOTICED.
State law requires the applicant to pay an abandonment fee as established by the City Council through a resolution. To determine the fee amount, the County Assessor must provide the City with the abandonment valuation of the Heers' property for the City to determine the value of the abandonment fee. The abandonment fee must be determined and authorized by the City Council as part of their consideration of the abandonment request. There is a delay with the County Assessor process in providing the valuation of the property. Therefore, staff is recommending the continuation of the request to a date certain on November 8, 2017 to provide the County Assessor ample time to provide the required assessment of the property.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
